subject: Abdul El-Sayed
claim: "I actually never, never called for defunding" the police.
claim_source_type: news report of statement (Detroit News quote relayed by CNN/Bridge)
explanation: In 2020 he described defunding as "disinvesting in the means of incarcerating someone" and WDET reports he called it "a sentiment he agrees with." Nuance: he also said he did not use the slogan and preferred "re-funding." Rated misleading, not false. Also see Bridge: https://bridgemi.com/michigan-government/fact-check-abdul-el-sayeds-record-on-defund-the-police-republican-meddling/

subject: Hasan Piker
claim: Democratic criticism of him was coordinated by AIPAC ("AIPAC boss call was made").
claim_source_type: news report of his social post (original post not located)
explanation: Stated as fact; no record or evidence of a coordinating call was presented or found. FEC data can show AIPAC-affiliated money to specific critics but cannot show a coordinated call. Democratic Majority for Israel called it baseless (reported).
